title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
authors: J. Su, Y. Lu, S. Pan, A. Murtadha, B. Wen, Y. Liu
before: Position was added to embeddings, either with sinusoids or learned vectors.
problem: Added position vectors extrapolate badly past the trained length and encode distance only indirectly.
breakthrough: Rotate query and key vectors by an angle proportional to position, so attention scores depend on relative distance by construction.
why: Adopted by Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek and most others. It is the position encoding of the current era.
next: Position interpolation and YaRN extend RoPE to longer contexts.
inherits: Relative position through rotation, in nearly every open model you will run.
